outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Ontario's premier says trade war would be 'devastating' for US and Canada; Mass shootings rock 2 US cities, leave 3 dead, 18 injured: Police; Tropical Storm Karina strengthens into a hurricane in the Pacific.

items.headline: Ontario's premier says trade war would be 'devastating' for US and Canada
items.detail: Ford also called Trump's renaming of Lake Ontario "disappointing."

items.headline: Mass shootings rock 2 US cities, leave 3 dead, 18 injured: Police
items.detail: Shootings in Chicago and Trenton, N.J., over the weekend left two dead and 18 injured.

items.headline: Tropical Storm Karina strengthens into a hurricane in the Pacific
items.detail: It could become a major storm this week, forecasters say.

items.headline: WATCH: Divers save the day for bride-to-be
items.detail: A group of divers from the Hudson Valley Commercial Diving School happened to be at the restaurant where Denise Rivera dropped her engagement ring into the Hudson River.

items.headline: WATCH: Woman alleges she was ejected from mountain coaster in Colorado
items.detail: A woman alleges she was thrown from her seat, dragged along the tracks and seriously injured as a result.
